rules.description: PEM private key or certificate block

kubeconfig or cluster credential fragment (value-shaped: a bare mention of the field name, e.g. governance prose explaining that no kubeconfig lives in this repo, does not fire — only field-name-plus-value or the serviceaccount token mount path do; also matches a YAML block-scalar indicator — `|` or `>`, optionally `-`/`+` chomped — immediately after the field name at end of line, the ordinary way a multi-line kubeconfig value is pasted into a runbook, per R2 residual R-1)
cluster-local, tailnet, or otherwise private hostname
IPv4 loopback address (127.0.0.0/8), split from private-network-address so published surfaces can classify it explicitly

build cache, remote executor, or gRPC endpoint literal (value-shaped: grpc(s):// must be followed immediately by a host, so prose like "grpc:// endpoints" listing the forbidden shape as a category does not fire)
localhost or a bound development port
source map or developer-only artefact leaked into the public build
absolute path from a developer or CI machine

personal name shaped as an initial-plus-surname, beyond any operator-consented initial (Unicode-aware: matches accented/non-ASCII letters, e.g. Nunez-with-tilde or Etienne-with-acute, not just A-Z/a-z)
archive link for the private keyholders role list
